title: Foreign Banks
definition: Foreign banks are banking institutions headquartered in a foreign country that operate branches, subsidiaries, or representative offices within India under the regulatory framework of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and the Banking Regulation Act, 1949.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in Prelims regarding RBI regulations, WTO commitments, Priority Sector Lending (PSL) norms, and Wholly Owned Subsidiary (WOS) models; relevant in Mains for understanding financial globalization, capital flows, and foreign direct investment in the banking sector.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Foreign Banks.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
